title: What might not return after Covid: heavy gear
summary: MR asks what they might not go back to, such as carrying heavy PA gear; DD joins in.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: Yeah. And along those lines I’m wondering if things miraculously return to normal in fairly short order, are there things you were doing before that you might not go back to because you found that it would be easier not to?
What are you talking about, teaching or playing or anything?

I guess I’m talking about like in my case I found that, you know most of the gigs I play are as a keyboard player. So I’ve got all this gear. And you know sometimes I have to bring my own PA system and carry it up out of the basement and put it in the car, and that part I’m not missing. So I guess it’s almost like I’m asking this question of myself.
How much does it weigh, man? That’s the thing. You know our gear keeps getting heavier. I don’t know about you but that’s what I find.
